title: Would you wear this to a winery? Matilda Baxter shocks onlookers
text:
By MONIQUE FRIEDLANDER, ASSISTANT SHOWBUSINESS EDITOR, AUSTRALIA

Published:  13:20 AEST, 21 September 2026   |  Updated:  17:16 AEST, 21 September 2026

An Australian influencer who underwent the controversial 'Barbie waist' procedure has stunned onlookers with her extremely skimpy outfit while dining at a South Australian winery.

Matilda Baxter, 23, who goes by the online moniker 'Tilds Search', described the awkward encounter in a TikTok video on Saturday, revealing the family seated nearby were left aghast by her cut-out crop top and low-slung maxi skirt.

'The family in particular across from us, motherf**kers kept staring at us,' said Matilda, who was dining at McLaren Vale winery with her boyfriend Alessandro.

'The mum was like in shock that I wore this. Like, sorry sweetheart, if you do see this, I am walking advertisement, this is my uniform, this is my work uniform. I look f**king good.'

Matilda, who has poured hundreds of thousands of dollars into her surgically enhanced aesthetic, continued: 'I spend that much money on myself, why not show it off, OK? If you see this, diva, maybe you should too.'

Elsewhere in her video, the brunette admitted that she was 'getting freaky in the car' with her beau on the way home after indulging in more than a few wines.

'We did a wine pairing, we were absolutely side-f**king-ways,' she mused.

'I was like, "Yeah, we'll just have a little bit of a wine". No, we had about 10. Well I did, Alessandra didn't, it was just so funny.'

It comes after Matilda lashed out over cruel comments about her changing appearance earlier this month.

'If you have to put me through a group chat to talk s**t about how different I look, saying that I look like a Holocaust survivor with bolt-ons, then you are the lowest of the low,' she began the lengthy rant.

'Let's dive a little deeper into this... You are allowed to look completely different from how you looked a year ago, or a week ago, or ten minutes ago,' she continued.

'If you're liking, commenting, sharing, putting it in group chats, b***hing, the negativity only brings money towards me.

'I love how people say, 'You are unrecognisable'. Like I was supposed to be offended. Dig up the old photos, keep b***hing about it, keep comparing, because at the end of the day I'm still a topic of discussion.'

Matilda went on to show photos of herself before she underwent the Barbie waist procedure and what she estimates is $50,000 to $100,000 worth of plastic surgery, and insisted she is happy with her new look and enjoying the attention it attracts.

'If it's a group chat, a conversation, a headline, whatever, I'm still a topic in your boring f***ing life, okay? It makes me money,' she said.

'Some people glow up and grow up, while all the others are in comment sections and group chats bullying and b***hing.'

The influencer then showed off how small her surgically enhanced waist is, demonstrating how it is narrower than her hands, and her new Chanel bag, which she also held up for comparison.

'If I'm being talked about in your group chat, clearly I've won the game,' she concluded.
